name: Oh Jellies!
summary:
The sea is full of bright, squishy jellyfish - and they love sticking together. Drag them onto the board and join four or more matching jellies to make them burst into shimmering light!
But the real magic happens afterwards…
When a group pops, the jellyfish above fall into place - and if they match, they pop too! Set off satisfying chain reactions, clear huge combos, and watch the board explode in color.
